value.rationale: The radical and socle dimensions, together with generator action ranks, are canonical invariants for modules over the square-zero two-loop local algebra. Their complete joint finite-field census is a meaningful arithmetic refinement of a classic representation variety, distinguishes profiles invisible to individual ranks, and gives a sharp feasible-parameter classification over arbitrary fields. This exact four-index answer is not a renamed single-operator count or arbitrary slice.
